name: @orchestrator-ai/shared-contracts-v2
description: Shared OpenAPI v2 contracts and generation scripts.

scripts.generate:ts: echo 'Generating TypeScript interfaces...' && mkdir -p generated/typescript && npx openapi-typescript contracts/common-types.yaml --output generated/typescript/common-types.ts && npx openapi-typescript contracts/agent-types.yaml --output generated/typescript/agent-types.ts && npx openapi-typescript contracts/a2a-protocol.yaml --output generated/typescript/a2a-protocol.ts && echo "export * from './common-types';\nexport * from './agent-types';\nexport * from './a2a-protocol';" > generated/typescript/index.ts && echo 'TypeScript interfaces generated.'
scripts.generate:py: pip install datamodel-code-generator > /dev/null && echo 'Generating Python models...' && mkdir -p generated/python && datamodel-codegen --input contracts/common-types.yaml --input-file-type openapi --output generated/python/common_types.py --target-python-version 3.9 --use-schema-description && datamodel-codegen --input contracts/agent-types.yaml --input-file-type openapi --output generated/python/agent_types.py --target-python-version 3.9 --use-schema-description && datamodel-codegen --input contracts/a2a-protocol.yaml --input-file-type openapi --output generated/python/a2a_protocol.py --target-python-version 3.9 --use-schema-description && touch generated/python/__init__.py && echo 'Python models generated.'
scripts.generate: npm run generate:ts && npm run generate:py
scripts.lint:contracts: redocly lint contracts/a2a-protocol.yaml && redocly lint contracts/agent-types.yaml && redocly lint contracts/common-types.yaml
